basic_details.job_title: NIFTEM-K Assistant Registrar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli (NIFTEM-K) has notified 1 vacancy for the Assistant Registrar post. Eligible regular employees of the Institute can apply through the offline application process by submitting complete applications along with all requisite supporting documents through the proper channel, duly forwarded by the Head of the Department/Office, to the Personnel Section, NIFTEM-K, Kundli on or before 31 October 2026. Applicants must possess a Master's degree or its equivalent in any discipline from a recognized University with at least 55%

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a Limited Departmental Examination (LDE) conducted with a Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) in accordance with the Recruitment and Promotion Rules (RPR), 2026, of NIFTEM-K. The minimum qualifying marks in the LDE shall be decided by the Competent Authority for all categories of employees. Recommendations of the DPC are subject to the approval of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post notified in NIFTEM-K Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIFTEM-K has notified the post of Assistant Registrar (Group A, Pay Level-10).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available under the unreserved (UR) category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Master's degree or its equivalent in any discipline from a recognized University with at least 55% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is required for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have 4 years administrative experience in Pay Level-8, 5 years in Pay Level-7, or 10 years in Pay Level-6 (or equivalents).

faq.question: Q6. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are open only to eligible regular employees of NIFTEM-K.

faq.question: Q7. How should applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the proper channel, duly forwarded by the Head of the Department/Office, to the Personnel Section, NIFTEM-K, Kundli.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure?
faq.answer: Selection is conducted through a Limited Departmental Examination (LDE) and a Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) as per RPR-2026.
